Tell us what you want to do.

We read every enquiry and answer by e-mail. For a problem with the map itself, the feedback button inside the map reaches us faster.

What you want to do, by when, and where it would appear.

To be named: the name to show, the month you gave, and an optional line of up to 140 characters. We check the gift by hand before listing it.

Where the problem is (the page or file), how to reproduce it, and what it lets someone do. Please do not include anyone else's personal data, and do not run destructive or mass tests against the live site. Only IntMap's administrators read this.

What happens to your enquiry

  • It is stored in IntMap's database (Supabase) and read only by IntMap's administrators.
  • It is used to answer you and for nothing else — no newsletter and no list is built from it.
  • Enquiries are deleted 730 days after they arrive; one marked as spam after 30 days. Ask us and we delete yours sooner.
  • Your network address is not stored. To limit abuse, the number of messages per connection is counted under a one-way code.
